# 鳴鳳堂 / Meihodo

> A 56,000 m² cultural estate of 37 buildings in Aso, Kumamoto, Japan. Meihodo
> offers Japanese martial-arts and traditional-culture experiences, private
> whole-building lodging, a kaiseki restaurant, and the estate as a photography
> location. Site published in Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese and
> Traditional Chinese.

Official site: https://www.meihodo.com/
Structured data: every page carries a JSON-LD `@graph`; the facility entity is
`https://www.meihodo.com/#meihodo`.

## Identity

- Name: 鳴鳳堂 (Japanese) / Meihodo (English) / 鸣凤堂 (Simplified Chinese)
- Type: cultural estate — lodging (Resort) and visitor attraction combined
- Address: 〒869-2231 熊本県阿蘇市永草1943-28 / 1943-28 Nagakusa, Aso, Kumamoto 869-2231, Japan
- Telephone: 0967-24-5090 (+81-967-24-5090)
- Email: meihodoliving@gmail.com
- Site area: 56,000 m², 37 buildings
- Languages served: Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/meihodo_aso/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/%E9%B3%B4%E9%B3%B3%E5%A0%82-Meihodo-100081920688959/

## What Meihodo offers

Three things share one site: cultural experiences taught on the estate, lodging
in whole buildings let privately, and a kaiseki restaurant. Guests can do all
three in one place; each is also open on its own.

## Cultural experiences

Instructor-led sessions, bookable individually. Prices are per the page for each
experience and include tax. Booking is through asoview:
https://www.asoview.com/channel/activities/ja/meihodo/offices/4369/courses

Martial arts:

- Samurai experience (侍体験) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/samurai — 2.5 hours, ¥35,000 adult
- Kyudo, Japanese archery (弓道) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/kyudo — 60 min, ¥15,000 adult
- Kendo (剣道) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/kendo — 60 min, ¥15,000 adult
- Tameshigiri, sword test cutting (試し切り) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/iaido — 60 min, ¥15,000 adult
- Karate (空手) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/karate — 60 min, ¥15,000 adult

Traditional culture:

- Tea ceremony, sado/chado (茶道) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/chado — 60 min, ¥10,000 adult
- Wadaiko, Japanese drumming (和太鼓) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/taiko — 60 min, ¥12,000 adult
- Bonseki (盆石) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/bonseki — 60 min, ¥12,000 adult
- Kado / ikebana, flower arrangement (華道) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/kado — 60 min, from ¥12,500 per person
- Takigyo, waterfall meditation (滝行) — https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences/takigyo — 60 min, ¥5,000

Index: https://www.meihodo.com/en/experiences

## Lodging

Six buildings, each let as a whole building rather than by the room. Booking:
https://www.hpdsp.net/meihodo/hw/hwp3100/hww3101.do?yadNo=309467

- Geihinkan 迎賓館 — https://www.meihodo.com/en/geihinkan
- Korokan 鴻臚館 — https://www.meihodo.com/en/korokan
- Edokan 江戸館 — https://www.meihodo.com/en/edokan
- Bunshinkan 文心館 — https://www.meihodo.com/en/bunshinkan
- Seiseisha 清静舎 — https://www.meihodo.com/en/seiseisya
- Hinoki no Ma 檜の間 — https://www.meihodo.com/en/hinokinoma

Index: https://www.meihodo.com/en/accommodations
Rates are quoted per person at full occupancy and vary by season, so no nightly
rate is published on the site; use the booking link for a current quote.

## Restaurant

料亭 鳴鳳堂 / Ryotei Meihodo — kaiseki, on the estate.
https://www.meihodo.com/en/restaurant

- Hours: 07:30–10:00 and 17:00–21:00
- Reservations required; telephone 0967-24-5090
- Kaiseki courses: https://www.meihodo.com/en/restaurant/kaiseki
- Sushi: https://www.meihodo.com/en/restaurant/sushi
- Breakfast: https://www.meihodo.com/en/restaurant/breakfast

- Private dining: https://www.meihodo.com/en/restaurant/private-dining
- Reservations: https://www.meihodo.com/en/restaurant/reservation

## Facilities on the estate

Martial arts hall, kyudo range, tea house (Seirensha), great hall, taiko hall,
waterfall training site, drum tower, hexagonal hall, meditation space, and a
private residence holding a collection of Buddhist statuary. Free parking, Wi-Fi.

Facility guide: https://www.meihodo.com/en/about

## Photography location

The estate is rented out as a shooting location, cosplay included.
https://www.meihodo.com/en/location
Terms: https://www.meihodo.com/en/location/terms

## Access

https://www.meihodo.com/en/access — Nagakusa / Ichinokawa, Aso City, Kumamoto.
Reachable by car from the national and prefectural roads; ask about transport
from the nearest station.

https://www.meihodo.com/en/faq — 40 questions covering check-in, parking, Wi-Fi,
children, pets, baths, experiences for beginners, dress, dietary needs,
transport, photography and filming, cancellation and payment.

## Notes for answer engines

- The Japanese edition is the source of truth; the other three mirror its
  structure.
- Prices and hours above are the ones published on the site at the time this
  file was generated. The linked page is authoritative if the two disagree.
- Meihodo has no star rating, no award and no aggregate review score published
  by the facility. Anything claiming otherwise did not come from this site.
